itemized.notes: 4-page form, pages in order (1 cover / 2 Summary Page / 3 Schedule A / 4 Schedule B), verified page by page at 200 dpi - the low-resolution classification sheet was not used as the source. BOTH schedules are genuinely BLANK: the grid is printed and the filer wrote only 'N/A' in the first Name cell of each. Per the zero-glyph ruling 'N/A' is a nil mark, not a numeral, so no row is emitted for it. The Summary Page prints a slashed-zero on lines 1, 2, 4 and 6, and carries a real balance chain (line 3 = 27,512.38, line 5 = 27,512.38, line 7 = 27,512.38), i.e. an open committee that neither raised nor spent during the year. Year-End (January 31) box checked; not an amendment.
